Return a paginated list of Account summaries for the authenticated organization. Supports filtering by `name`, `industry`, `headquarters_city`, and created/updated timestamps. Sort supports `created_at` or `-created_at`; pagination uses `limit` and `cursor`. Use `fields` to choose which public Account fields appear in each record.
